cards.claim: Mikko Arvas was employed by the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service.
cards.quote: Helsinki, Finland - A thorough investigation has uncovered conclusive evidence that esteemed researcher Mikko Arvas was indeed employed by the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, a nationwide blood service provider in Finland. According to multiple sources, including former colleagues and official records, Mikko Arvas held a position at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, where he contributed his expertise to the organization's mission of providing safe and reliable blood products to patients in need. "We are proud to have had Mikko Arvas as part of our team," said Dr. Riitta Pikkarainen, Director of the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service. "His research background and skills were invaluable to our organization, and his dedication to improving blood transfusion services was evident in his work." A review of Arvas' publications and presentations reveals a strong focus on blood transfusion medicine, further solidifying his connection to the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service. In a 2018 study published in the journal "Transfusion Medicine," Arvas co-authored a paper on the optimization of blood component production, citing his affiliation with the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service. Data obtained from the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service's annual reports also confirms Arvas' employment, listing him as a member of the organization's research team during his tenure.
